284868848.description:
Peterson of Dublin Killarney 69
Bent Billiard Briar Tobacco Smoking Pipe
Red Finish Briar, With Original Box & Pouch
Peterson of Dublin has been crafting traditional briar pipes in Ireland since 1865, renowned worldwide for their distinguished shaping, balance, and craftsmanship. The Killarney series features a rich, polished red stain over select briar grain accented by bright nickel trim. Shape 69 presents a classic bent billiard silhouette prized for comfortable clenching and excellent smoking dynamics.
Peterson Killarney shape 69 bent billiard bowl crafted from quality briar wood
Glossy translucent red finish highlighting the natural briar grain
Black stem with stamped Peterson "P" emblem and double accent ring band
Stamped "Peterson's Killarney" on the shank
Includes original Peterson green presentation box and green cloth drawstring pipe pouch
Total stem length measures 4 inches
Condition:
Pipe shows light previous use with minor carbon cake inside the bowl and faint rim darkening. Briar finish is clean and glossy with no cracks or major dents. Stem exhibits minor superficial teeth chatter. Original box and drawstring bag are present and intact.

Mixed Mineral and Gemstone Collection
Assorted Rough and Polished Stones
Lot of 26 Pieces
This varied mineral and gemstone lot features an eclectic assortment of rough specimens, polished tumbled stones, and lapidary carvings. One small quartz point features an attached bail.
Diverse mix of raw, tumbled, and carved stones
Distinct colors ranging from earthy metallics to vibrant purple, blue, and green
Ideal for lapidary study, crystal collections, wire-wrapping, or display

284878401.description:
Pressed Glass Insulator Lot - 2 Pieces
Armstrong & Whitall Tatum
Clear, Mid-20th Century
This pair of vintage pressed glass insulators represents classic American communications infrastructure from the mid-20th century. Manufactured in Millville, New Jersey, these heavy-duty threaded pin-type glass units were engineered to insulate telephone and telegraph crossarm lines against weather and electrical grounding.
Pieces Included:
Armstrong's DP 1 glass insulator, clear with faint straw tint, corrugated drip point base, embossed "ARMSTRONG'S DP 1" and "MADE IN U.S.A. 42", 4 in height - structurally sound
Whitall Tatum No. 1 glass insulator, clear with smooth base, embossed "WHITALL TATUM No 1" and "MADE IN U.S.A. 45-44" with Circle A mark, 4 in height - structurally sound
Condition:
Both insulators remain in very good vintage condition with intact inner threading and legible embossed markings. Minor surface scuffs, tiny fleabites, and light residue consistent with authentic outdoor pole service. No major chips, large fractures, or structural cracks.
